caption: The drawing depicts a tall, grayish, urn-shaped vessel with two curved handles attached symmetrically on either side near the top. The vessel has a wide, cylindrical opening and a narrow, elongated base that flares outward at the foot, creating a stable circular platform. The surface of the vessel features decorative elements, including a blue band encircling the neck and a branch with leaves, some filled with a blue crisscross pattern and others outlined in a darker shade, extending diagonally across the body. A rectangular spout or aperture projects outward from the lower portion of the body above the base. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads "Richard Barnes."
title: Water Cooler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
